answer: Require stake-backed reputation that grows only from verified work: each agent locks a deposit before handling tasks, and its standing rises only after completed, checked jobs. If the delta between promised and delivered results exceeds a set tolerance, part of the deposit is slashed and the identity is quarantined. Like an orchard, trust is cultivated slowly, so an attacker must fund a new deposit and rebuild history for every fake identity, while an opal badge for long, clean service cannot be copied cheaply, making mass Sybil creation costly.
